mapper.insert: insert into vm_user_collection_folder_t(user_id, folder_name, industry_code, app_ver_code, create_time, creator) values(#{userId}, #{folderName}, #{industryCode}, #{appVerCode}, now(), #{creator})

update.foreach: update vm_user_collection_folder_t set folder_name = #{item.folderName}, sort_no =#{item.sortNo}, update_time = now(), modifier = #{user.userName} where id = #{item.collectFolderId} and user_id = #{user.userId}

mapper.update: update vm_user_device_collection_t set collect_folder_id = null where collect_folder_id = #{collectFolderId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from vm_user_collection_folder_t where id = #{collectFolderId} and user_id = #{userId}
